scope: 11/23~11/27 표현 28개 중 14개 + 지난 오답 4개 + 2주 지난 표현 2개
grading_rule: 정답 1, 부분 정답 0.5(철자 한 글자·관사·시제만 틀림), 오답 0, 빈칸 0. 품사까지 틀리면 0. 영작(C·D)은 지정 패턴을 썼으면 틀 0.5, 패턴 뒤 절에 주어·동사가 맞게 있고 뜻이 통하면 절 0.5.
memo: 이번 주 표현 28개(단어 16·패턴 12, 11/24 카드 없음) 중 단어 8개·패턴 6개를 날짜별로 고르게 뽑음(A8·B6·C4·D2). 지난 오답 중 한 번도 재출제하지 않은 prioritize·accurate를 A로, 두 번 연속 틀린 feasible·log를 새 문장 B로 재출제(11/14·11/21 시험은 아직 채점 전). 유지율은 2주 넘은 withhold(11/05)·overdue(11/10).

questions.prompt: (절차·양식을) 간소화하다 — make simple / make easier 대신
questions.note: 짝꿍: streamline the process / streamline the form. 과거형 streamlined.

questions.prompt: Overtime without the manager's approval is u___________ and will not be paid.
questions.note: 승인받지 않은, 무단의. un + authorized. unauthorized overtime / unauthorized change.

questions.prompt: "I'd like your input on ~ before I ~."으로 영작: 새 통근버스 노선을 본사에 보내기 전에, 그 노선에 대한 의견을 듣고 싶습니다. (주어·동사 넣기)
questions.answer: I'd like your input on the new bus route before I send it to HQ.
accept: I would like your input on the new bus route before I send it to head office.
I'd like your input on the new shuttle bus route before I send it to HQ.
questions.expression: I'd like your input on ~ before I ~.
questions.note: input on + 명사, before 뒤 주어 I + 현재형 send(will 안 씀).

questions.prompt: 우선 처리하다, 먼저 하다 — do first 대신
questions.note: 짝꿍: prioritize the urgent items. 명사 priority. 10/31 오답 첫 재출제.

questions.prompt: Please l__ every visitor's name and arrival time in the gate book.
questions.note: 이름·시간·수치를 대장에 적어 둔다. log ~ in the book. 두 번 연속 오답이라 새 문장으로 재출제.

questions.prompt: 잠정적인, 아직 바뀔 수 있는 — not final 대신
questions.note: 짝꿍: a tentative date / tentative choice. 부사 tentatively.

questions.prompt: "Please do not ~ without my prior approval." 패턴으로 고쳐 쓰기: Don't buy new office chairs if I didn't say OK first.
questions.answer: Please do not buy new office chairs without my prior approval.
accept: Please don't buy new office chairs without my prior approval.
questions.expression: Please do not ~ without my prior approval.
questions.note: do not 뒤 동사원형 buy, without 뒤는 명사(my prior approval).

questions.prompt: The power cut on Monday may d______ production on Line 3.
questions.note: 일정·작업에 지장을 주다. may 뒤 동사원형. 명사 disruption.

questions.prompt: (지급·승인을) 보류하다 — not pay yet / stop for now 대신
questions.note: 짝꿍: withhold payment until ~. 과거형 withheld. 11/05 표현(2주 이상).

questions.prompt: "I have yet to receive ~, which I asked for on ~."으로 영작: 11월 24일에 요청한 10월 결근 보고서를 아직 받지 못했습니다.
questions.answer: I have yet to receive the October absence report, which I asked for on Nov 24.
accept: I have yet to receive the absence report for October, which I asked for on November 24.
questions.expression: I have yet to receive ~, which I asked for on ~.
questions.note: have yet to + 동사원형. which 뒤 주어 I + 과거형 asked for.

questions.prompt: (자료·숫자·번역이) 정확한 — correct / right 대신
questions.note: 짝꿍: accurate data / accurate translation. c 두 번. 10/31 오답 첫 재출제.

questions.prompt: Is it f_______ to finish the fire drill before the buyer audit next week?
questions.note: 현장에서 실제로 할 수 있는지. Is it feasible to ~? 두 번 연속 오답이라 새 문장으로 재출제.

questions.prompt: (하겠다고) 확답하다, 약속하다 — say yes / promise 대신 (뒤에 to)
questions.note: 짝꿍: commit to a date / commit to a clause. 과거형 committed(t 두 번).

questions.prompt: "Until ~ is updated, please ~ for now."으로 영작: 시스템이 고쳐질 때까지 우선 입고 수량을 손으로 적어 주세요. (주어·동사 넣기)
questions.answer: Until the system is updated, please write the receiving quantity by hand for now.
accept: Until the system is updated, please write down the received quantity manually for now.
questions.expression: Until ~ is updated, please ~ for now.
questions.note: Until 뒤 주어 the system + is updated, please 뒤 동사원형 write.

questions.prompt: Please list the o_______ spare parts that we can sell or throw away.
questions.note: 더 이상 안 쓰는. obsolete parts / obsolete fabric. 끝이 -lete.

questions.prompt: (문제가) 다시 발생하다 — happen again 대신
questions.note: 짝꿍: make sure it does not recur. 과거형 recurred(r 두 번).

questions.prompt: "I'll ~ and go over it with you before ~." 패턴으로 고쳐 쓰기: I will make the training plan. Then we look at it together before next Friday.
questions.answer: I'll make the training plan and go over it with you before next Friday.
accept: I'll prepare the training plan and go over it with you before next Friday.
I will make the training plan and go over it with you before next Friday.
questions.expression: I'll ~ and go over it with you before ~.
questions.note: 주어 I + will make, and 뒤 go over it with you. 두 문장을 and로 한 문장.

questions.prompt: The water bill for October is o______, so please pay it today.
questions.note: 기한이 지난. an overdue bill / overdue report. 11/10 표현(2주 이상).

questions.prompt: 상한을 두다, 상한 — set a maximum 대신 (세 글자)
questions.note: 짝꿍: cap ~ at ~ (cap the order at our budget). 과거형 capped.

questions.prompt: "Please let me know what caused ~ and when ~ will ~."으로 영작: 지게차 고장의 원인과 수리가 언제 끝날지 알려 주세요. (주어·동사 넣기)
questions.answer: Please let me know what caused the forklift breakdown and when the repair will be finished.
accept: Please let me know what caused the forklift problem and when the repair will be done.
questions.expression: Please let me know what caused ~ and when ~ will ~.
questions.note: what caused + 명사, when 뒤 주어 the repair + will be finished.
